about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's final engine round): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan at (2,2) with a folder of DarkPlus * and Cannon * in both games (BN5's chips 190 and 1; BN6's 290, the chip of DarkPlus's name, its record BN5's DarkPlus in what it does where BN5's ROM is read, src/core/chips.c, and 1), both picked on the first Custom screen and OK (BN6's deck four DarkPlus more before them, which the guest battles' rule shelves as the first screen opens, a BN5 DarkChip out of the first hand but where he worries or is dark, four at most: src/emu/soulmood.c, compact; BN5's deck dealt as the spec writes it); KnightSoul held in both (flags5, souls6), so BN6's engine has the Souls and with them BN5's mood and DarkChip rule (S7). DarkPlus used at t30 runs BN5's misc family's subfamily 3 moved (0x0800E190): its power, 50, stored as the bonus of the hand's next chip, the Cannon (hand +0x1A, BN6's reader the same: its use adds it to the Cannon's 40), MegaMan flashing green 24 frames (BN5's AIData +0x3C, kept apart by BN6's engine: src/emu/xchips_flash.c), sound 0x157; dark for the battle and DarkPlus's after-effect (NaviStats +0x31 = 1) by BN5's rule; the Cannon used at t100 strikes for 90. Every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md).
